one_liner: Shared inbox and customer communication hub for support/sales teams.

auth.evidence_quote: Front requires that public integrations use OAuth unless there is a reason they cannot.
auth.notes: API tokens are Bearer tokens created in Settings > Developers; OAuth uses authorization-code grant only and is required for public/partner integrations.

access.evidence_quote: Front offers a 14-day free trial that includes all features from the Professional plan - no credit card required.
access.notes: No perpetual free plan; API token/OAuth credentials can be obtained during the 14-day trial without a credit card. Evidence quote from search summary, not a direct fetch of front.com/pricing.

api.evidence_quote: Front's MCP server is in open beta and everyone has access
api.notes: Official MCP server confirmed via search results (open beta); not independently fetched.

verdict.rationale: OAuth or API-token credentials are obtainable via a no-credit-card 14-day trial, with an official MCP server available.
